prompt: A vertical photograph taken just before dawn at a cheap package hotel pool on the Spanish coast. The camera sits low at the edge of the water, looking along the pool deck. The underwater lights make the pool glow a cold fluorescent teal, and that glow is the only light, washing the pale wet tiles. Tight rows of white plastic sunloungers line the deck, and every single one has a plain beach towel spread neatly flat across it, corners squared. Nobody is anywhere. Behind them, a dark concrete hotel block with unlit balconies. Shot on Cinestill 800T, heavy grain, slight halation, lonely and quietly eerie. Thanks.
